diagnostics.message: :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references

The EKS cluster should wait for the cluster IAM role to be created before it is submitted. Its role_arn comes from a conditional local that can select an existing-role data source, so there is no reference to the managed role in this graph; when manage_cluster_iam_resources is enabled the cluster can race role creation.

Worker instances may launch before the worker-node IAM policy is attached. The Auto Scaling group depends on its launch configuration, but neither has an ordering dependency on this policy attachment; the node group path explicitly gates creation on worker policy attachments, indicating this readiness ordering matters.

The launch-template Auto Scaling group can launch worker instances before the worker-node IAM policy attachment is complete; no attribute reference or explicit dependency orders this ASG after the attachment.
